sql: SELECT o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId = 'NCT01764633' LIMIT 5
rows: Events that occurred from randomization to the last confirmed survival status date; the median duration of follow-up was 26 months. KM estimates at 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 and 36 months are reported.
